cause: Training/serving skew from a missing log transform on f3. Over the 200 entities common to both tables, f1, f2, f4, f5 match exactly (mean-abs-diff = 0, corr = 1.0), while f3 diverges (mean-abs-diff = 7.07, corr = 0.89). The relationship is exact: serving_f3 = exp(training_f3) - 1 (verified mean-abs-diff = 2.6e-6, and corr(training_f3, log1p(serving_f3)) = 1.0). So the training pipeline applies a log1p transform, f3 = ln(1 + raw_value), but the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value. The log1p feature transformation was omitted (or applied differently) in the serving feature-computation path.
